caption: The drawing features a single vertical object resembling a staff or rod positioned in the exact center of the composition. At the top of this object is a forked, abstract shape with curved extensions on either side, rendered in dark pencil or ink. Midway down the staff, a textured flag-like shape extends to the left, attached with a small circular form at the connection point. Approximately one-third from the bottom, two sets of elongated, curled leaves or petal-like forms, also rendered in dark tones, radiate outward symmetrically from the central axis. The entire composition is monochromatic, consisting of shades of black and gray on an off-white background. The drawing is centered on the page with significant empty space around the subject. There is a small inscription in the lower right corner.
title: Wrought Iron Weather Vane
